purpose: Exploratory static quota calibration, not a validated performance model or an adaptive boundary observer.
execution: One fresh hosted runner and stack per quota/repetition. Apply fixed limits before continuous load; no intervening pauses, quota updates, rollbacks, or safe-baseline exclusion. Three measurement windows are repeated observations, not independent replications.
load_rationale: 40 checkout operations/s retains the busy checkout profile. 100 ad requests/s is deliberately below all ten archived reference busy baseline goodputs (minimum about 406/s). Unlike the previous closed-loop ad generator, the offered ad rate cannot rise when its quota increases. This is a new controlled-load setting, not a reproduction of the previous load.
capacity_rationale: Checkout: 40/s times two 5-second timeouts = 400 concurrent operations. Ads: 100/s times a 2-second connect plus a 2-second RPC = 400. Each executor preallocates exactly 512 VUs and never allocates dynamically.
measurement: Per-operation start and finish records, checkout HTTP durations, actual starts/completions/drops, client outstanding operations, CPU use/throttling, host/generator pressure, memory, restarts and OOM. Client outstanding operations are not internal server queue lengths; timeouts can leave server work outstanding.
labels: Checkout SLO uses p95 of completed checkout requests in each operation-start cohort and unsuccessful (finished-failed, unfinished, or dropped) attempts. Post-quota restart/OOM is diagnostic, never an exclusion. Missing primary records or generator failure is infrastructure-invalid; load-delivery mismatch is reported separately with outcomes retained.
analysis: Report every runner and all three post-warmup windows, actual rate, p95/error outcomes and outstanding counts. Report observed quota bands and mixed outcomes, without majority tests, fitted boundary guarantees or choosing a best-looking window. Static reproducibility does not establish validity during adaptation. No model is fitted in this campaign.
retry: Infrastructure-failed jobs may be rerun with the same design and quota. Record run attempt. Do not retry unsafe but technically completed trials to obtain a safe result.
